# Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack

- Creator: Quaternius
- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatedanimatedcharacter.html
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Retrieved from the official download linked by the source page.
- Files used unchanged: `Worker_Male.fbx`, `Worker_Female.fbx`, `Casual_Male.fbx`, `Chef_Female.fbx`.
- In-place animation libraries used unchanged: `Animations/UAL1_Standard.fbx` and `Animations/UAL2_Standard.fbx`.
- Animation source: Quaternius Universal Animation Library 1 and 2, Standard editions.
- Animation viewer/source: https://quaternius.com/animviewer.html

The generated Riverworks prefabs bake the source material colors into vertex
colors. The source FBX files remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
